messages:
toni.dx: Quick: community reports Next edge sample failing with "ReferenceError: require is not defined" after deploy. Likely our CJS entry being selected in edge builds.
sam.sdk: Confirmed. Some bundlers resolve main -> dist/index.cjs; edge runtimes have no require.
ria.build: Current package.json exposes import+require in exports and main -> cjs. That combo confuses certain toolchains.
omar.docs: Onboarding friction: quickstart still shows CommonJS snippets. People paste into edge apps and hit this. Need docs flip to ESM-first.
sam.sdk: Short fix: add top-level "types": "dist/index.d.ts" for editor discovery, change exports so import/default -> ./dist/index.mjs and put CJS under a "node" condition only.
ria.build: I'll validate the exports shape and publish a canary. Also add an npm pack + vercel build smoke test in CI.
toni.dx: Please also update the sample app to use ESM imports and add an "edge note" to the quickstart.
ci-bot: smoke-tests kicked off for branch canary/esm-edge. Results to follow.
sam.sdk: Long-term: consider ESM-only package + separate @redwood/inference-cjs. RFC later.
toni.dx: Thanks — Ria, post the canary tarball here when ready so DX can test.
